instruction: Look at freecad_task-13_input.step in FreeCAD. Create a toothed index rotor from the annular disk. Keep the outside radius 55 mm and thickness 12 mm. Enlarge the center bore to diameter 28 mm, add and fuse a top hub of diameter 40 mm and height 10 mm centered on the bore, and keep the center bore open through the hub. Cut sixteen identical radial rectangular notches through the outside rim, each 20 mm long radially and 7 mm wide tangentially, starting at radius 41 mm and extending outward; place the first notch on +X and pattern the rest every 22.5 degrees. Cut six vertical through bolt holes of diameter 6.4 mm on radius 34 mm, starting on +X and repeating every 60 degrees. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-13_output.step using only FreeCAD GUI operations; do not use external scripts.
